theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (Φ : Eucl n → Eucl P) (Ω : Set (Eucl n)) (A : Set (Eucl P)) (Y : Eucl P → Eucl P), IsOpen Ω → ContDiff ℝ 1 Φ → (∃ K : ℝ≥0, LipschitzOnWith K Φ Ω) → (∃ κ : ℝ, 0 < κ ∧ ∀ w ∈ Ω, ∀ w' ∈ Ω, κ * ‖w - w'‖ ≤ ‖Φ w - Φ w'‖) → A ⊆ Φ '' Ω → NullMeasurableSet A (μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl P)) → IntegrableOn Y A (μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl P)) → (∀ᵐ x ∂((μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl P)).restrict A), ∀ w ∈ Ω, Φ w = x → Y x ∈ LinearMap.range (fderiv ℝ Φ w).toLinearMap) → ∃ c : Eucl n → Eucl n, IntegrableOn c Ω (volume : Measure (Eucl n)) ∧ (∀ w, w ∉ Ω ∩ Φ ⁻¹' A → c w = 0) ∧ ∀ᵐ w ∂((volume : Measure (Eucl n)).restrict (Ω ∩ Φ ⁻¹' A)), fderiv ℝ Φ w (c w) = Real.sqrt (Matrix.of fun i j => inner ℝ (fderiv ℝ Φ w (EuclideanSpace.single i 1)) (fderiv ℝ Φ w (EuclideanSpace.single j 1))).det • Y (Φ w)
